result.title: PersonaCodeBench: Evaluating Coding Agents in Persona-driven Human-Interactive Sessions
result.summary: Coding agents must deliver correct software while respecting users' expertise, preferences, and working conditions. Existing benchmarks increasingly incorporate interaction, yet personalized requirement fulfillment remains underexplored. We introduce PersonaCodeBench, which turns user characteristics into verifiable obligations in persona-driven multi-turn coding sessions. Our persona pool spans roles, technical abilities, interaction preferences, and practical constraints, yielding task-grounded evolved requirements for implementation, permissions, testing, explanation, and delivery. At runtime, a controller governs user simulator responses and requirement disclosure, using online requirement evaluation to provide feedback and advance the interaction. Requirements emerge progressively, with their content, disclosure conditions, and acceptance criteria fixed before evaluation. A completion verifier and a personalization verifier separately assess native correctness and persona fulfillment. Joint pass requires both adherence to the declared budget and compliance with validity conditions. We evaluate all major frontier agents, establish a comprehensive leaderboard, and conduct detailed experimental analyses to validate effectiveness. PersonaCodeBench supports reproducible evaluation of coding agents' ability to meet explicit, personalized user expectations alongside coding objectives.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PersonaCodeBench，将用户画像转化为可验证要求，在多轮交互式编程会话中评测编码代理的个性化需求满足与正确性。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作聚焦编码代理的用户画像与软件交付评测，不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态，也未提供可用于 LVR 的状态表示、证据筛选或停止决策的具体方法线索，故排除。
